description.en: Bruce is the elite commando of the SARS. In a battle with terrorists, he was seriously wounded and the entire regiment was destroyed. When he woke up again, he found himself lying in the secret laboratory of the enemy. It turned out that he and several former comrades, as the first batch of experimental products, were transformed into terrorist war machines. In all the machines, Bruce found that only he still retains the original consciousness… but his body is not under his control, and he is sent to the front line again and again to kill his former comrades, even to love himself. The task of the family… After watching his beloved daughter fall under his gun, Bruce is determined to get rid of the machine program settings, wake up all the experimental war machines, and give the terrorists a "great counterattack."

Bai Pingting has always been unable to believe the saying "a woman's virtue is ignorance". She is a maid of Jing Anwang, but she lives even better than some wealthly women. She is also wiser than most men and she hopes for a higher intellect.  
  
Even if that man is an enemy, both are full of lies and conspiracies. She is not fond of that man. But between a choice the love and loyalty, she will begin to think that she isn't as meaningful as she once thought she was…  
  
Note: the manhua went on a hiatus after 2 vols. And is completely scanlated

description.en: Xiao Chen, a time-traveler nearing the age of one hundred, was peacefully preparing to spend the rest of his life. Suddenly, a system activated, rewarding him for his family’s childbirth. Not only would he become stronger, but his lifespan would also reverse! “Procreate, quickly procreate!” he exclaimed. “Everyone in the family, regardless of age or gender, give birth, give birth, give birth!”
description.pt-br: Xiao Chen, um viajante do tempo com quase cem anos, preparava-se pacificamente para passar o resto de sua vida. De repente, um sistema foi ativado, o recompensando pelo parto de um novo descendente. Ele não apenas se tornaria mais forte, mas sua expectativa de vida também seria revertida! “Procrie, procrie rapidamente!” ele exclamou.

description.en: One day, countless sinister and distorted monsters suddenly appeared in the city. These monsters would attack or distort the minds of ordinary people at night, turning them into demons. The government called these monsters "The Terror". To deal with the terror attacks, and the higher-ups of the government officials and businessmen created a floating city to remotely control the whole world. However, the majority of people still live on the ground, reproducing and working.

he/him

Boss of [Mosspaca Studio](https://mangadex.org/author/7693b699-f55c-4714-9ea4-efdb346b57d7/mosspaca-studio).

After he graduated from China Central Academy of Fine Arts in 2010, he established the studio «Mossapaca» dedicated to create and develop Chinese manhua. As the scenarist of «Joker Danny», he is also an artist of other projects.

Artist of [Mosspaca Studio](https://mangadex.org/author/7693b699-f55c-4714-9ea4-efdb346b57d7/mosspaca-studio).

She publishes her webcomics on her weibo account.
She has never claimed to be trans or even brought the subject up, but uses male pronouns on her Weibo account because of her Mosspaca character.

from [illustratorslounge.com](http://illustratorslounge.com/fashion/manga-mondays-old-xian):
"Old Xian (Old先) is based in Hangzhou, China. She graduated from the Central Academy of Fine Arts (CAFA) in 2013. Whilst at university she meet a writer called Moss. The two decide to collaborate and released two manhuas before even graduating. In 2012 they released The Specific Heat Capacity of Love as well as Xiao Chou Dan Ni (aka Clown Danny). Xiao Chou Dan Ni earned Old Xian a Shueisha Tezuka Award and a Golden Dragon Awards."

He then mistakenly entered a brothel looking for a meal, which again disappointed his bride. His father-in-law hence sent him to their family's training hall to fend for himself. But because he had travelled through time, he gained a tattered reincarnation bowl that requires him to swallow objects of all kinds...

Luckily, this sect is overflowing with buffs, and I managed to awaken the Favorability Index System—collecting profiles of powerhouses, earning favorability points, and using their abilities. description.en:
Because of you, I can have hope for the future. I'm willing to pay any price for these true feelings.

Because of an unfulfilled desire, Yongen appears before Yingzi as a ghost. With Yongen having lost her memories, will Yingzi help her recall her incomplete wish?

For a wish, Mari breaks off a sambar deer's antler, which causes her body to change in strange ways. How will Hezhou help her best friend return the antler and make everything right?

Lanying is immediately drawn to Yansheng, who is fated to bear her family's curse. How will Lanying give it her all to help the person she loves escape her fate?

Mirong and ah-Mao were just online friends at first. After a trip to see different tiger gods, they come to learn more about each other. What will happen between them as they grow ever closer?

Four stories, four relationships. They might only have been a brief part of each other's lives, or they might have left a deep imprint in each other's hearts. But it's doubtless that their heartfelt emotions are worth treasuring.

If not, I’ll never survive past episode three!Even though I say that he’s a typical fodder, why does this little brat have such good luck with women? Maids, rich daughters, lolis, mature ladies, even… Cross-dressers. Gosh, why wasn’t my past life this fulfilling? The world is a big place, but I’ve only been nesting inside a cyber cafe my entire past life… In this life, I’ll go around this prosperous world (with the ladies)! Après de nombreuses tentatives de la part de l'Alpha, Chu Hezhou réussit finalement à flirter avec l'Oméga. Mais contre toute attente, Ruan Xingshu semble être plus brutale qu'il ne le laisse paraître et par la suite, un Alpha de deuxième année appelle Ruan Xingshu "frérot", à présent Chu Hezhou ne sait plus où il en est. description.en: "Aunt, when I grow up… will you marry me?" No… No way! The kid was already thinking about making her his wife, but she is a minor immortal from the Immortal Yin World. She could not get together with a young human boy, no matter how ordinary she was. Yet, 500 years later, she was sent to congratulate the Yang Demon World’s young lord, Li Ye on his wedding. Wait a minute, the young lord looks familiar. Also, that woman he’s marrying is the physical body she left behind in the human world. To make things worse, he did not recognize her, and was trying to get her killed… Should she tell him the truth and clobber the brat’s handsome and immaculate face?
description.fr:
"Ma Tante, quand je serai grand... vous m'épouserez ?" 
"Non... Pas question !" 
Le gamin pensait déjà à en faire sa femme, mais c'est une immortelle mineure du Monde Immortel Yin. Elle ne pouvait pas se marier avec un jeune humain, aussi ordinaire soit-elle. Pourtant, 500 ans plus tard, elle a été envoyée pour féliciter le jeune seigneur du Monde du Démon Yang, Li Ye, pour son mariage. Attendez une minute, ce jeune seigneur lui dit quelque chose. De plus, la femme qu'il épouse est le corps physique qu'elle a laissé derrière elle dans le monde des humains. Pour ne rien arranger, il ne l'a pas reconnue et tente de la faire tuer... Devrait-elle lui dire la vérité et écraser le beau visage immaculé de ce morveux ?

After dying in an accident, Luyi is resurrected into a different body, only to find out that his old archenemy, Gu Jiangyuan, has had a crush on him for many years... 
While having his enemy become his lover is one thing, what's with the baffling ghost exorcism missions, as well as Gu Jiangyuan wanting and trying to get rid of the present-him just to bring back the original "Luyi"?!

description.en: Na Ning was mistreated in her previous life, and in her next life, she vowed to make those who harmed her pay double for what they did to her. On her next journey, she was constantly faced with danger. She only trusted herself, only to find that things were not as simple as she thought. Love and regret entangled together, chaos and war rising, the political power is changing. And her memory came back to her as if she just woke up from a dream. It turns out that everything was part of a conspiracy that has nothing to do with him! She meets him again, but as a stranger. Can they let go of the past and continue to move on?
Fun facts you probably didn't know!
description.es: "456 Endfield!?" es una serie oficial de cómics digitales de corte cómico ambientada en el universo del RPG Arknights: Endfield y una continuación indirecta de 123 Rhodes Island. Esta obra adopta una estructura de tira cómica de cuatro viñetas (estilo yonkoma) para narrar, en clave de humor y de forma no canónica, los sketches más rápidos y absurdos de la rutina en el planeta Talos-II.

description.en:
Finding himself back in time 10 years ago, though technically an almost parallel world in 2009, Pei Qian got a system where he gets money to run his business. 

The funds for business and personal use are separated. 

After a set period, he can earn his personal funds according to how much his business funds he has left. 

The catch? Pei Qian earns more when he makes a loss in his business funds.

Happily thinking how easy it would be, with many failed start-ups proving a point, Pei Qian founded his company Tengda and achieved financial freedom through the losses. 

Unfortunately, fate has other plans for him.

- - -
Best boss ever, prodigy of the business world, genius creator, visionary of the century. These are the descriptions used for Pei Qian, President of Tengda Corporation. Ever since his rebirth, Pei Qian finds himself in possession of a system that rewards him if he manages to lose money. Instantly, a brilliant idea comes to mind — making crappy games!

description.en:
A thousand years ago, she was a small tree spirit that fell in love with the Water God. After enduring a tragic love story where the water god was decimated, she lived alone into the modern times, becoming the owner of a dessert shop named "Non Stop". 

Her specialty is a type of tea called Blissful Life, which attracts all sorts of weird customers. Every customer that drinks her tea, they all end up telling her their life story, and these stories are often the love stories of demons and beasts, filled with passion and vengeance.

description.en:
“If the Aslan family knew other genes had “invaded” their bloodline, they might hurt your twins!”

Magic, mecha, mana, demon foxes, and space travel. There’s a lot that’s unique about Mu Yunshen’s world. Most interestingly... for a select few men, pregnancy is also a possibility. Of course, Mu Yunshen doesn’t know about this last little detail—yet. After he saves the life of young master Aslan and spends the night with him, Mu Yunshen ends up with the shock of his life: twins.
description.es-la: Mu Yunshen salvó la vida de un joven militar en un accidente. Después del incidente, regresó a su ciudad natal con gemelos en su vientre. ¡Resulta que esa noche fue un plan premeditado por ese joven militar! ¡¿Qué puede hacer ahora ?! ¡Parece que no puede escapar!

description.en: In order to find out how her brother went missing, Ye chu applied into a prestigious Academy of fine arts. When she started to investigate there, she found her brothers old work in a art galley, and at the silence of the night she was sucked into the art work. Get ready to see the unsolved mysteries of this investigation.
